description: Forward one message to the addresses you name, with the files it carries, inside the thread it already sits in. Only the provider's own limit applies to what it carries. Call this only when the person asked for this message to go; when they asked to prepare one, draft it instead. A request id already spent sends nothing again: the answer says whether that send went or may have gone.

html.description: Your own words as HTML, for formatting; note stays their plain-text version. An Outlook mailbox keeps only the HTML and writes the plain version from it.

mailbox.description: The mailbox's name or its email address.

note.description: Your own words, above the message forwarded.

requestId.description: Your own id for this send, new for every message. One whose send went or may have gone sends nothing again.

to.description: Who the forward is addressed to.

name: messages_forward
title: Forward a message
